subject: Storix renewal: growth plan, term options & QBR scheduling
content:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ella Ramos <ella.ramos@storix.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@storix.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Storix renewal: growth plan, term options & QBR scheduling

Hi Ella and Daniel,

Congrats again on a strong finish to the year — usage trends look healthy. Were kicking off Storixs renewal conversation and want to align on capacity needs, term options (12 vs 24 mo), and a QBR to walk through a mutual action plan before your renewal window.

Key asks from our side to make the QBR productive:
- Confirm expected committed throughput increase (tokens/day or peak qps) for 2028 (you mentioned ~20% growth).
- Procurement contact and any preferred PO timeline.
- Any compliance evidence we should bring (SOC, data residency, allowed IPs).

I attached a short draft mutual action plan and a usage snapshot to seed the discussion. Proposed QBR windows: Jan 23–25 (were suggesting Jan 24 at 10:00 AM PT). If that works, well send a calendar invite and a one-pager pricing outline ahead of time.

Next steps (for the thread):
1) Ella / Daniel: confirm capacity delta and procurement contact
2) Redwood: share pricing scenarios for 12/24-month terms + recommended reserved capacity
3) Schedule QBR and distribute MAP + usage artifacts

Thanks — looking forward to locking timelines.

Cheers,

Markus Klein
Senior Manager, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments (stub): Storix_MAP_draft_v1.docx (docx), Usage_Snapshot_Q4-2027.csv (csv)

From: Ella Ramos <ella.ramos@storix.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@storix.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@storix.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 10:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Storix renewal: growth plan, term options & QBR scheduling

Thanks Markus — appreciate the write-up.

Short answers:
- We expect roughly 18–22% token growth YOY; peak qps likely +25% in new feature windows. I can confirm exact numbers with Daniel (cc'd).
- Procurement: procurement@storix.com (cc'd). Typical PO lead time is ~3 weeks; we can accelerate for renewal-critical items.
- Compliance: SOC2 and a brief vendor security questionnaire will be required; happy to provide the questionnaire now so you can scope evidence.

Jan 24 at 10:00 AM PT works for our people. Please include product, account, and security leads — I'll invite our TPM as well.

Can you also outline what reserved capacity delta we should scope for the preferred 24-month term?

Thanks,

Ella Ramos
Director of Platform Engineering, Storix Media

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 08:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Storix renewal: growth plan, term options & QBR scheduling

Hi Ella / Daniel —

Attached a quick pricing comparison for the scenarios we discussed (12 vs 24 months) and a recommended reserved capacity band based on observed Q4-2027 load. High level:
- 12-month renewal (flex): lower upfront commitment, higher unit cost; good if you expect volatility.
- 24-month renewal (commit + reserved): ~18% blended unit discount vs 12-mo and priority capacity allocation for peak windows.

Recommended reserved capacity: 1.25x your current 95th percentile token throughput to give headroom for the expected 20% growth; we can size burst pools separately.

I attached the Pricing_Comparison_2028.xlsx and updated MAP with milestones. For the QBR on Jan 24, we propose this agenda:
1) 15m — executive context & renewal goals
2) 25m — usage trends, capacity recommendation, pricing scenarios
3) 20m — compliance & procurement checklist (open items)
4) 10m — next steps and action owners

Please confirm attendees and well send the invite.

Best,

Markus Klein
Senior Manager, Sales Operations

Hi Markus —

We typically require a 3-week window for standard POs; for enterprise renewals we can turn faster if the vendor provides a signed SOW and the redlined contract in advance. Please confirm whether Redwood can accept our standard vendor form (attached in a follow-up) and provide a SOC2 summary or point to your compliance portal. Also need vendor banking details for PO issuance.

Procurement Team
Storix Media

Hi Procurement / Ella —

I can take point on compliance evidence. We have a SOC 2 summary and recent audit report; attaching a short summary for procurement review. If Storix has a vendor questionnaire we can fill it out in parallel — alternatively, we can provide read-only access to our secure compliance portal here: https://redwood.app/s/portal/storix-78921 (please confirm the email addresses that need access).

Also: can you confirm whether the increased capacity needs will require VPC/private deployment or whether hosted (with VPC peering) remains acceptable? That impacts lead time for reserved capacity.

I'll coordinate with our finance team for net-30/45 PO terms once we have the SOW.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
